div.span:
NOTES
• Conceptual star schema; not a physical table design.
• Grain: one row per SikaCredit loan.
• dim_customer uses the canonical OCB customer key: ocb_customer_id.
• dim_geography represents loan disbursement location, not customer location.
• Exact loan timestamp remains on the fact for temporal analysis.
• loan_id remains the business reference for the individual loan.
• No separate dim_loan is introduced in v1.0.0.
• Analytical measures and derived intelligence are excluded from this conceptual view.
